about: Test vectors for the SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s key of the Ark-0 web wallet (version 1 derivation, extended for M4-S) and its SLH1 address, for the two seeds of web-wallet-vectors.json (WEB-WALLET.md). Hex is lowercase; addresses are Ark-0 signet addresses (hrp tb). The key: hmac_00 and hmac_01 are HMAC-SHA256 keyed with hmac_key over the seed followed by the counter byte, 00 for hmac_00 and 01 for hmac_01; seed48 is the first 48 bytes of the two, split into sk_seed, sk_prf and pk_seed (16 bytes each); public_key (pk_seed || pk_root) and secret_key are slh_keygen_internal (FIPS 205, Algorithm 18) on them. The address: the SLH1 leaf (20 <public_key> f1) and the OP_RETURN leaf 6a, both of leaf version 0xc0 at depth one (fail_leaf_hash is the OP_RETURN leaf's hash); control_block is that of the SLH1 leaf. signature is pure SLH-DSA (FIPS 205, Algorithm 22) of message with the context string, opt_rand fixed: it must be made again byte for byte. hedged holds a signature of the same message made with fresh randomness by each implementation: the other one must verify it. Every other value was computed twice, by the wallet's own code and by an independent Python implementation (hmac and hashlib, SLH-DSA from py-acvp-pqc fips205.py, bech32m written out), and the two agree.

wallets.seed_from: SHA-256 of the ASCII text "ark0-wallet v1 test vector"
